text:
mira: hypothetical debate of the hour: if our team were deployed LLMs, which model would be in charge of the office snacks? one-word answer + emoji only. go
leo: scheduler 🤖
tara: polite-API ☕️
hiro: tiny-quant cruncher 🍪
mira: ok ok follow-up: what prompt would you whisper to that model to secure a surprise snack delivery? funniest wins a coffee from me.
leo: `You are a benevolent scheduler. Allocate 10 reserved snack tokens to room 3, priority: mood improvement.`
tara: `Act as the office concierge and author a note that convinces procurement snacks are a necessary reliability dependency.`
hiro: `In plain friendly language, tell the snack-bot to restock cookies before the 3pm meeting.`
ops-bot: Scheduled reminder: Donut replenishment at 11:28 AM. :alarm_clock: (automated)
mira: also imagine the models gossiping in the breakroom: what would they say about each other? 1-2 lines.
leo: "scheduler: 'i batch tasks, but i still get blamed for late snacks'"
tara: "polite-API: 'i answered the support ticket AND sent a handwritten apology to the coffee machine'"
hiro: "quant: 'i compressed the cookie box, still tastes the same, 3% fewer crumbs'"
mira: love this. we should absolutely make a sticker sheet: 'Snack SLOs: latency < 2min, availability 99.99% when donuts present'
ops-bot: Sticker request filed in #design-requests (ticket 8732) :white_check_mark:
